lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Coach,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: what do you think is the most important part of cheerleading?
Engaging with the audience.
Putting on a great performance.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Oh, so that's what you were thinking?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: That makes me feel great since that's what I'm in charge of!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I can see why you'd feel that way.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Bay's amazing performances

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: are the crux of Rewind.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: When Bay gets on the stage, she shines like no one else.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I had no idea you felt that way, Coach!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I was just mindlessly scrolling through the internet

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: when I saw people arguing about which mattered more: audience engagement or the actual performance.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: It was like super intense! T_T

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: If you dared to go against the grain, they'd tear you apart in a heartbeat!
What do you guys think?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: That's easy.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: That's easy.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: It's both.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: It's both.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Whoa, our minds are totally in sync!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Feels awesome, hehe!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: It's only natural since we're a team.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: If either of us disagreed with the other,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: it would have been really difficult for us to work as a team.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You're so cool when you're breaking things down, Bay.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Rewind is gonna become a team

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: that doesn't lack in any area,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: be it audience engagement,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: or the actual performances themselves.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Any audiences who come to see our shows

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: won't be disappointed.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: We've been practicing super hard every day!
I'm looking forward to seeing you perform.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Thanks! Hehe!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: We can't wait for you to see it!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We recently started practicing a new routine,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: so we'll give you a sneak peek soon.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We'd love to hear your honest feedback.
Sure, contact me anytime.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I knew we could count on you, Coach!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Yeah, thanks, Coach.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We'll contact you soon.
